subject: general
question: Who among the following received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award of 2019 in the Kathakali classical dance category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kottakkal Nandakumaran Nair.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kottakkal Nandakumaran Nair:-**

 
 
• He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award of 2019 in the Kathakali classical dance category.
 
• He is a renowned Kathakali artist from Kerala.
 
• He has also won other prestigious awards like the Padma Shri and Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi Award. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** OS Arun:-**

 
 
• He is a Carnatic music vocalist who has won several awards including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the Carnatic vocal music category in 2018.
 
 
 
• **Manju Nandan Mehta:-**
 
 
• He is a renowned theatre director and actor who has won several awards for his contribution to theatre.
 
 
 
• **Vinayak Torvi:-**
 
 
• He is a Hindustani classical vocalist who has won several awards for his contribution to music.
